# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g

# Verify the number of rows after dropping
print('Rows after dropping missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g:', len(penguins_clean))

# Compute the Pearson correlation
correlation = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])
print(f'Pearson correlation coefficient: {correlation:.4f}')}}
